title: BioCortex Track B production-shaped evidence envelope isolated-lab KAT v1
description: Closed-world schema for the two exact track-specific variants of a nonsecret, deterministic, production-shaped isolated-lab parser KAT. This is not an operational production evidence schema, is never production-admissible, and conveys no runtime, provider, evidence-acceptance, custody, trust, signer, time, replay, owner, or downstream-gate authority.
$comment: Byte framing is enforced independently by the pure parser: exact bytes, UTF-8 without BOM, no outer whitespace or concatenated JSON, recognized compression signatures and enumerated compression/URI/reference metadata shapes rejected, at most 1048576 input bytes, depth 32, 256 members per object, 64 items per array, 4096 total JSON nodes, signed 64-bit integers, and no floating-point values. Closed-world envelope review, not shape enumeration, rejects every additional field.
